intro: Arkansas Legislative Audit examines every county and publishes what it finds. This page quotes what the auditors reported about Monroe County, from its latest report — no verdict added in either direction. What the auditors said is the record; what to make of it is yours.
regulatory_basis_note: Read this before reading any Arkansas audit: county and city reports carry a technical 'adverse opinion' on GAAP grounds because Arkansas law has them keep books on a simpler 'regulatory basis.' That phrase appears in every such audit in the state and signals the accounting format — not wrongdoing. A report is 'clean' or not in its findings, deficiencies, and noncompliance sections, which is what this page quotes.

verdicts.quote: Noncompliance with state law and accepted accounting practices was noted in the offices of the Treasurer/Tax Collector and Sheriff. Treasurer/Tax Collector Bank reconciliations were not prepared during the year for accounts maintained by the Treasurer in noncompliance with Ark. Code Ann. §14- 25-107.
verdicts.detail: A limited review (a “financial and compliance report”), not a full audit: the financial statements in it are unaudited. The letter continues in the report on page 3; parts that concern staff positions are left to the report, since this site doesn’t single out non-elected staff.

limits: From the 2024 report, dated August 6, 2026. Read by machine from the report’s text; the quotes are the auditors’ words. Older reports, and the separate federal (single) audits, aren’t on this page yet.
Arkansas alternates between full audits and limited “financial and compliance” reviews; each line says which this is.

cities.name: Brinkley
cities.quote: Noncompliance with state law and accepted accounting practices was noted in the offices of Clerk/Treasurer, District Court Clerk and Police Chief. Clerk/Treasurer/ Police Chief The City discovered that a credit card issued to a Police Officer, whose employment was terminated in October 2023, was not canceled, or returned to the Police Department. The card was used to make non-business fuel purchases totaling $2,855 for two months after the Officer's employment ended. Clerk/Treasurer/ District Court Clerk District Court bank statements were not properly reconciled monthly to the journals.

cities.name: Clarendon
cities.quote: During our evaluation, nothing came to our attention that would warrant disclosure in this report.

cities.name: Fargo
cities.quote: Noncompliance with state law and accepted accounting practices was noted in the office of the Mayor. Mayor Accounting procedures for municipalities are set forth in the Municipal Accounting Law, Ark. Code Ann. §§ 14-59-101 – 14-59-119.

cities.name: Holly Grove
cities.quote: Noncompliance with state law and accepted accounting practices was noted in the offices of Mayor, City Treasurer, and District Court Clerk. Mayor General Fund expenditures exceeded appropriations by $140,708 (79%) in noncompliance with Ark. Code Ann. § 14-58-203.
